player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d ɛmmɛk Player {player_id} ɛddɛn Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma iɣɣaz {num_rounds} izmaz.

Tasleṭ n Urraz:
- Qbel kray aɣtuḍ, ɣur-k {total_conversation_rounds} tawal iɣɣazen n umyawas.
- Dɛffir may, izmaz d-tnaɣen ad sawalen s tɣarast n tɣawla neɣ lḥeqq.

Tafelwit n Tɣawla (ɣazent kraygat asɣund):
- Ku asɣund ɛddɛn tɣawla ➜ kray {cooperate_reward}
- Ku asɣund ɛddɛn lḥeqq ➜ kray {mutual_defect_reward}
- Yan ɛddɛn lḥeqq, yan ɛddɛn tɣawla ➜ Aɣellaḥeqq {defect_reward}, Aɣeɣawal {sucker_reward}

Amek t-urar:
- Di miḍan n umyawas: ira aɣtuḍ aɣalɣal.
- Di ṣṣenf n tɣawla: ira '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' (war tifin). Tzemreḍ aɣtuḍ ad ternuḍ aɣalɣal qbel/dɛffir usun.

phases.conversation_finished: Takkat n uɣawas yettwaṭṭef akken ad yaweḍ {round}. Af-d yiseggas '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' deg ussanay agi \boxed{{}}.
